body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Mobience(representative Ahn Jae-woo, www.mobience.com) introduced wireless qwerty keypad 'SmallQWERTY' supporting phone call functionality using Bluetooth communication at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA for 4 days from January 6.

'SmallQWERTY' is Bluetooth keypad which can use for the existing laptop as well as smartphone and Tablet PC etc. Its design and functionality drastically upgraded compared to the prior product. It supports mouse functionality as same as touchpad of general laptop by loading touchpad at the back side.

In particular, with 'Phone Call' funtionality, users can answer a call for iPhone and Galaxy Tab with 'SmallQWERTY'. It is possible thanks to speaker and microphone at the back side and AVING experienced the clean voice quality.

Also call recording is possible by supporting T-Flash memory slot for iPhone which doesn't have call recording functionality. It notifies when it is far from pairing smartphone using vibration, to prevent losing phone and it's possible to recharge when connecting smartphone with 'SmallQWERTY'.
